leaf.text:
This leaf is valid if subleaf 0's @domain_lcpus_count > 0.
AMD CPUs client code should use this leaf, instead of leaf 0xb, if available. That is, if leaf 0x80000000's @max_ext_leaf ≥ 0x80000026.

subleaf.text: Subleaf ID acts as the domain level specifier. Clients should keep iterating on all subleaves until hitting a level with @domain_lcpus_count = 0.

bit0.desc: Bit width of this level (previous levels inclusive)

bit29.desc: This core has a power efficiency ranking
bit29.text: If set, power efficiency varies across cores. This core's power efficiency ranking is provided at @core_pwreff_ranking.

bit30.desc: This domain level has hybrid (E, P) cores

bit31.desc: The 'Core' domain has asymmetric cores count

bit0.desc: Number of logical CPUs at this domain instance
bit0.text: If @domain_type = 1 (Core domain) and @domain_core_count_asymm is set, this logical CPUs count will differ across different instances of the domain level specified at @domain_level.

bit16.desc: This core's static power efficiency ranking
bit16.text: This field is valid iff @core_has_eff_ranking is set. Lower values indicate better power consumption (and a potentially lower performance potential).

bit24.text: This field is valid iff @domain_type = 1 (Core domain).

bit28.text: This field is valid iff @domain_type = 1 (Core domain).

bit0.desc: x2APIC ID of current logical CPU
bit0.text: The APIC ID is always valid and does not vary along with subleaf index.
